You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make leche flan, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Whisk the egg yolks gently to avoid bubbles (5 minutes)
Step 2. Pour the custard mixture into the caramelized molds (3 minutes)
Step 3. Combine condensed milk and evaporated milk in a large bowl (4 minutes)
Step 4. Arrange the molds inside a large steamer tray (5 minutes)
Step 5. Strain the custard mixture through a fine mesh sieve (10 minutes)
Step 6. Wash and dry the llaneras or flan molds (10 minutes)
Step 7. Preheat the oven or prepare the steamer water (15 minutes)
Step 8. Place the llaneras over low heat to melt sugar (8 minutes)
Step 9. Separate egg yolks from whites carefully (12 minutes)
Step 10. Gather all necessary ingredients from the pantry (10 minutes)
Step 11. Add a teaspoon of vanilla extract to the mixture (1 minute)
Step 12. Measure out exactly one cup of granulated sugar (2 minutes)
Step 13. Zest one fresh lime for added aroma (5 minutes)
Step 14. Clear the kitchen counter for a workspace (10 minutes)
Step 15. Set a kitchen timer for the baking duration (1 minute)
Step 16. Check the water level in the steamer base (2 minutes)
Step 17. Stir the egg yolks into the milk base (6 minutes)
Step 18. Organize the mixing bowls and whisks (5 minutes)
Step 19. Let the finished flan cool at room temperature (1 hour)
Step 20. Prepare a hot water bath or bain-marie (10 minutes)
Step 21. Inspect the molds for any cracks (2 minutes)
Step 22. Wipe the rims of the molds with a damp cloth (3 minutes)
Step 23. Locate the aluminum foil roll (2 minutes)
Step 24. Find the heavy-duty oven mitts (1 minute)
Step 25. Soften the chilled eggs to room temperature (30 minutes)
Step 26. Slice the lime in half (1 minute)
Step 27. Lay out a clean towel on the cooling rack (2 minutes)
Step 28. Steam the flan on medium-low heat (45 minutes)
Step 29. Open the cans of condensed and evaporated milk (3 minutes)
Step 30. Sterilize the stirring spoons (10 minutes)
Step 31. Incorporate the sugar into the egg-milk blend (5 minutes)
Step 32. Prepare the refrigerator shelf for the molds (5 minutes)
Step 33. Cut the aluminum foil into squares (4 minutes)
Step 34. Grease the bottom of the llaneras with a little butter (6 minutes)
Step 35. Double-check the steamer lid seal (2 minutes)
Step 36. Remove the flan from the heat source (1 minute)
Step 37. Check the inventory of white sugar (2 minutes)
Step 38. Take the milk cans out of the cupboard (2 minutes)
Step 39. Blend a pinch of salt into the mixture (1 minute)
Step 40. Caramelize the sugar until golden brown (12 minutes)
Step 41. Juice the lime into a small ramekin (3 minutes)
Step 42. Carefully cover each llanera with aluminum foil (8 minutes)
Step 43. Clean the stovetop burners (15 minutes)
Step 44. Sharpen the knife for zesting (5 minutes)
Step 45. Fetch the steamer from the high shelf (5 minutes)
Step 46. Rinse the lime thoroughly (2 minutes)
Step 47. Place the flan in the refrigerator to set (6 hours)
Step 48. Buy a fresh carton of eggs (20 minutes)
Step 49. Prepare the serving plates (5 minutes)
Step 50. Measure the evaporated milk (3 minutes)
Step 51. Scrape the lime zest into the custard (2 minutes)
Step 52. Chill the serving plates (30 minutes)
Step 53. Measure the condensed milk (3 minutes)
Step 54. Test the firmness of the flan with a toothpick (2 minutes)
Step 55. Slowly pour the liquid into the caramel-lined molds (5 minutes)
Step 56. Clean the mixing area (10 minutes)
Step 57. Look for the hand whisk (2 minutes)
Step 58. Run a knife around the edges of the mold (4 minutes)
Step 59. Fill the steamer pot with three inches of water (3 minutes)
Step 60. Sanitize the workspace surface (10 minutes)
Step 61. Ensure the caramel has hardened in the molds (10 minutes)
Step 62. Set out the cooling wire rack (2 minutes)
Step 63. Tap the molds gently to remove air bubbles (3 minutes)
Step 64. Fold the kitchen towel (2 minutes)
Step 65. Sift the sugar to remove lumps (4 minutes)
Step 66. Seal the edges of the foil tightly (5 minutes)
Step 67. Rinse the zester tool (2 minutes)
Step 68. Refill the water in the steamer (3 minutes)
Step 69. Stir the zest into the milk (3 minutes)
Step 70. Invert the flan onto a large platter (2 minutes)
Step 71. Prepare a secondary bowl for egg whites (3 minutes)
Step 72. Distribute the caramel evenly across all molds (5 minutes)
Step 73. Pour the evaporated milk into the main bowl (2 minutes)
Step 74. Turn on the stove to a low flame (1 minute)
Step 75. Take the eggs out of the carton (1 minute)
Step 76. Whisk the salt into the yolks (2 minutes)
Step 77. Check the oven temperature with a thermometer (5 minutes)
Step 78. Bring the milk to room temperature (20 minutes)
Step 79. Dust the countertop (5 minutes)
Step 80. Purchase a new bottle of vanilla (15 minutes)
Step 81. Check the expiration dates on the milk (2 minutes)
Step 82. Open the vanilla bottle (1 minute)
Step 83. Sieve the sugar into a measuring cup (4 minutes)
Step 84. Place the molds into the hot water bath (4 minutes)
Step 85. Mix the vanilla into the custard (2 minutes)
Step 86. Garnish the flan with a slice of lime (2 minutes)
Step 87. Wash the knife used for sharpening (2 minutes)
Step 88. Add the condensed milk to the bowl (3 minutes)
Step 89. Allow the caramel to cool slightly (7 minutes)
Step 90. Pour the sugar into the llaneras (2 minutes)
Step 91. Adjust the stove flame height (1 minute)
Step 92. Swirl the melting sugar to coat the bottom (5 minutes)
Step 93. Wipe down the exterior of the milk cans (2 minutes)
Step 94. Slice the flan into individual portions (5 minutes)
Step 95. Remove the foil from the molds (2 minutes)
Step 96. Calibrate the kitchen scale (5 minutes)
Step 97. Coat the inside walls of the molds with caramel (6 minutes)
Step 98. Separate the last two eggs (3 minutes)
Step 99. Pour the milk mixture through a strainer (8 minutes)
Step 100. Rinse the llaneras one last time (3 minutes)
